variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders 'the branch of my planting', a first-person possessive matching the qere מַטָּעַי ('my planting'); the ketiv מטעו would give 'his planting'. The parallel 'the work of my hands' in the same clause confirms the first-person reading, and no ASV note offers 'his planting'.
